name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart end-to-end. The API key was already exported in the environment. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present). Created the quickstart script following the docs' Python (OpenAI SDK) example. The model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` specified in the quickstart docs returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error, so I substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` (an available chat model from the models list). The script then ran successfully and returned the chat completion: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned 404 NOT_FOUND ('Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'). I had to query the available models endpoint and substitute with `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` to get a successful chat completion response.

env_ready.evidence: python3 --version && pip3 --version returned Python 3.14.4 and pip 26.0.1

installed.evidence: pip install openai reported Requirement already satisfied: openai in /usr/local/lib/python3.14/site-packages (2.33.0)

configured.evidence: FIREWORKS_API_KEY is set: yes and the script loaded it via os.environ.get("FIREWORKS_API_KEY")

first_call.evidence: The first python3 fireworks_quickstart.py run with model deepseek-v3p1 exited 1 with openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404

verified.evidence: The final python3 fireworks_quickstart.py run with model glm-5p2 exited 0 and printed ¡Hola!

friction.detail: The docs-specified model string failed immediately: model="accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1" produced openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...

friction.where: Models list endpoint vs chat completions
friction.detail: A model returned by the API list (deepseek-v4-pro) was also unusable: accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro appeared in the curl list but then produced openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...

The user had to manually query and parse the models endpoint to guess a working substitute: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | head -c 2000

The quickstart example omits any note that the example model may need deployment or be outdated, forcing trial-and-error substitution: model="accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1" in the initial script
